# victorops_team_membership (Resource)

Associates a user with a team in VictorOps/Splunk OnCall.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "victorops_team_membership" "jdane_platform" {
  team_id   = victorops_team.platform.id
  user_name = victorops_user.jdane.user_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) The slug/ID of the team.
- `user_name` (String) The username of the user to add to the team.

### Optional

- `replacement_user` (String) The username of a replacement user. Required when deleting a membership.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import victorops_team_membership.jdane_platform <team_id>/<username>
```
